data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 刚晒好的毛巾
data.description: 庭院里的毛巾已经晒干。蕾娜把它们一条条叠整齐，发现最上面那条边角又歪了，便重新折了一次。
data.action: folding a towel on the veranda
data.promptProse: On the sunlit wooden engawa veranda of a traditional hot-spring ryokan, Lena carefully folds crisp, sun-dried white cotton towels into a neat, fragrant stack. A manicured Japanese zen garden with raked gravel and bamboo water fountains spreads out before her, bathed in warm, gentle afternoon sunlight.
